project_type: Vanilla JS cinematic experience platform (Kelza investor pitch deck)
language: JavaScript (ES modules, no bundler, no framework)
build_system: None (no bundler/build step). Static ES modules served directly.
test_framework: None (no test framework present). Validation is structural/AST-based.
test_command: NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check js/scenes/Scene006_Recognition.js && NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check js/engine/universe/RecognitionEngine.js && NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check js/engine/universe/PatternSuggestion.js && NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check js/engine/universe/NegativeSpaceDirector.js && NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check js/scenes/scene006/Scene006Phases.js
verification_instructions: Run node --check on all new/modified files to verify syntax. Verify no circular imports. Check that all classes follow patterns: <400 lines, no function >60 lines, zero allocations in update/render, pre-allocated pools.
setup_instructions: No setup needed. INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install possible.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - npm registry blocked. No npm install. No external dependencies. Must use only pre-existing project utilities (Noise, helpers). Must prefix all node commands with NODE_OPTIONS=''.
contribution_requirements: No function > ~60 lines, no class > ~400 lines. Zero allocations in render/update loops. No magic numbers. Everything modular, configurable, deterministic. Object pooling for all runtime data.
key_patterns: Scenes follow pattern: Scene class with getId/setUniverse/setConnectionData/load/enter/update/leave/destroy. Phase definitions in separate file (scene00X/Scene00XPhases.js). Settings in config/settings.js (Object.freeze). Constants in config/constants.js. Engine.js registers scenes, checks completion, calls transition methods. Subsystems use MANAGER_STATES lifecycle. Noise-based procedural values via utils/Noise.js. Pre-allocated result objects returned from queries (getInfluenceAt, getGraphMetrics, getParallaxOffset).
directory_structure: js/ contains: app.js (entry), config/ (constants.js, settings.js), engine/ (Engine.js, SceneManager.js, SceneDirector.js, CinematicTimeline.js, universe/ with all subsystems), scenes/ (SceneXXX files + sceneXXX/ subdirs for phases), effects/, shaders/, ui/, utils/ (helpers.js, Noise.js)
